text.intro: Backpocket is a monthly pocket gallery for artists to share work and make connections. Each issue is made with care for your enjoyment.
text.issue-lede: Backpocket is being made one issue at a time, with a first-issue release target of January 1, 2027. This space will hold the issue and confirmed order details when they are ready.
text.issue-title: a little heads up on whats about to happen.
text.issue-summary: A first issue will explain readers and artists about what they can expect from our zine every month.
text.about-lede: Backpocket is its own little world, Where people do not get curated each artist gets full creative freedom we dont tell people what to do.
text.gallery-lede:
Bort_
once upon a time they told me 
your only as good as what you can pull out of your backpocket.
text.order-info: Monthly issues are planned for Backpocket, a pocket gallery for artists to share work, with the first issue targeting January 1, 2027. Sign-ups are not open yet. Ordering is not open on this draft site, and it does not collect subscriptions, orders, payments, or donations. An optional donation may be offered to support the zine, but no donation method is set up. Price and postage details still need to be confirmed, along with the format, print and mailing schedule, subscription terms, and payment method, before sign-ups open. The release target is not a promise of postal arrival. If you want to hear when subscriptions open, check back here for a real signup link once it is ready.

text.about-6: Images, textures, phrases, odd observations: a starting point is allowed to be small.
text.about-9: Let research and experiments shift the idea. Nothing needs to be settled on the first pass.
text.about-12: A zine turns a private pile of things into something another person can hold and respond to.
